fittingPage.locationTitle: Where: Golf Son Gual, near Palma
fittingPage.locationBody: Your fitting takes place in my indoor studio at Golf Son Gual, just minutes from Palma de Mallorca. Climate-controlled, weather-proof, with the full range of heads and shafts on site.
fittingPage.techBody: I measure with a TrackMan 4 launch monitor — the same system used on the PGA Tour. Every shot gives precise data on ball speed, spin, launch angle and carry, instead of guesswork.
fittingPage.creditBody: The €90 is the fee for your 60-minute fitting session — including the full bag analysis and your personal build sheet. Whether you order clubs through me afterwards is entirely up to you.

faq.q: How much does a golf fitting on Mallorca cost?
faq.a: A fitting session lasts 60 minutes and costs €90. That's the fee for the session — with no obligation to buy clubs afterwards.

faq.q: Where does the fitting take place?
faq.a: In my indoor studio at Golf Son Gual, just minutes from Palma de Mallorca — with TrackMan and the full club selection on site.

faq.q: Do I have to buy clubs afterwards?
faq.a: No. You can book the fitting with no obligation to buy — the €90 covers the session either way.

faq.q: Should I bring my own clubs?
faq.a: You're welcome to, but it's not required. Bringing your current clubs lets us measure them as a benchmark. All test heads and shafts are on site.

faq.q: What handicap is a fitting worth it for?
faq.a: Every level — from high handicappers to scratch golfers. Properly fitted clubs help every player hit more consistent shots.

faq.q: What language is the fitting in?
faq.a: German, English or Spanish — whatever suits you best.

faq.q: How long does the fitting take?
faq.a: About 60 minutes for a single fitting. For a full bag analysis, please allow a little more time — just let me know.
